🛰️ A new update deployment is now underway!
This one focuses on refining the battlefield: Smarter terrain generation, improved performance, and a more consistent tactical experience across operations.
🗺️ Some tile layouts have been updated, creating slightly longer paths that give you a bit more time to handle the Artronids, while also enhancing overall pathfinding performance.
⚙️ On top of that, several key defenses have been recalibrated, from Joint Operations and Miradors to heavy artillery, to create more balanced encounters and smoother coordination between units.
♾️ Endless mode has also been improved, with performance refinements and tuning aimed at making each run more seamless and rewarding.
🗨️These changes are the result of your continued feedback and field reports. We sincerely appreciate and thank you for your inputs and your dedication!
Additions / Improvements: ✨
Attenuator and Amplifier targeting Advanced versions of a building now also affects the regular building type (aiming at an Advanced Mirador ban Miradors from reinforcements)
Laethissia now stays on the field between waves and gets its own damage entry

Tanks produced by the HQ now display the correct HP: Balance Changes: ⚖️

The final wave foe of “Threat Majoris” now has Rear Guard
Bryta’s nests no more count as an Entry Point

Decreased Howitzer position - Long barrel cost from 2000 to 1500

Decreased Howitzer position - Shrapnel loader cost from 600 to 500
Increased Retribution position - Interdiction protocol damage bonus from 50% to 75%
Decreased Decimation position - High-grade explosives cost from 390 to 200: Bug fixes: 👾
Fixed a localization issue on Supply reroute in non-English. It should read -10% Supply production instead of +10%.
Fixed an issue displaying a Talon airship as a weapon for Iron Dragoons HQ
Fixed an issue with Experimental xeno-amplifier - Cogno-analyzer giving only 20% Damage bonus instead of intended 50%
Fixed an issue forbidding to close a path containing an Entry point with a Pit
Fixed an issue in Endless, when Quit/Continue could reset the foes’ HP bonus
Fixed a very rare case of Pit spawning out of sequence
Fixed an edge case, when min range would be higher than max range, resulting in unexpected behavior
Fixed an issue, allowing regular and endless foes to spawn from Bryta nests
Fixed an issue of display, when too many Doctrines got acquired at the same time, resulting in a delay in refresh of the UI
Fixed several scenarios in which Entry points of Pits were not detected as such
This update mostly brings performance improvements to the battlefield. ⚙️💥
We have dedicated our recent efforts to optimizing game performance:
✅ Fewer slowdowns
✅ Faster path calculation
✅ A much smoother Endless mode, even with massive enemy waves
✅ And most importantly: The speed-up option (speed x3) now works much more smoothly at all times, without affecting the effectiveness of your units in terms of targeting and damage.
As always, we have also taken the opportunity to fix a few bugs and fine-tune the balancing. ⚖️👾

Thank you for your patience and commitment. It's thanks to your support that we can continue to move the game in the right direction. 🫶 In fact, many of your comments have already been taken into account and incorporated into our ongoing improvements. 💭🛠️
Additions / Improvements: ✨
Specific Defeat screen for Endless mode: Balance Changes: ⚖️

Increased Durendal position - Exposed elements damage bonus from 50% to 75%

The battle on multiple fronts is still raging: Commanders have often relied on drawing the enemy into a single kill zone. Now, with this update, a new era is coming: Defending across several fronts becomes just as viable, opening the door to new strategies and more dynamic gameplay. 🗺️

Each faction has received a major boost to help them handle pressure from all sides, and we’ll continue refining this feature so that every approach feels rewarding, whether through new mechanics, balance changes, or other improvements. 🎯🛡️
You’ll also notice UI upgrades, including a brand new counter for Fronts and Entry Points. And of course, a round of bug fixes to keep things running smoothly. ⚙️
Additions / Improvements: ✨
UI now displays Battlefront and Entry points counts (Glossary removed from the pause menu and added directly to the new in-game UI widget, as tooltips)
Alpha Lecos enemy now has a different model than the regular Lecos
Steel factory’s colors changed to be more easily distinguishable from Advanced Steel factory: Balance Changes: ⚖️
Officers Quarters - Underground train now reads “HQ +1 Range per Battlefront”
Officers Quarters - Company bugler now reads “Infantry HP increase by 40 per Battlefront”
Imperial Stronghold - Underground garage now reads “Each wave, spawns 1 Tank Auctoritas per Battlefront. Then 1 every 10 sec”
Barricade - Reinforced frame now reads “+125% HP, +25% per Battlefront”
Increased Commissar Anysia’s Grenadier production from every other wave to each wave
Threxid now has Overwatch power, increasing reroll costs by 250
Decreased Medacris HP from 300 to 280: Bug fixes: 👾
Fixed a visual issue, displaying buildings merged with platforms
Fixed an issue with Reload Speed on Super Heavy Pulse Cannon
🎮 Gameplay: Threats are now revealed one wave earlier! That’s one precious extra wave to get organized, tweak your strategy, and prepare for what’s coming.
📡 Tactical Intel: Weapons stats are finally here! Enable the option in your settings and dive into the numbers like the battle-hardened strategist you are.📊📈

🔧 Performance: We noticed Endless Mode might be demanding on some CPUs under certain conditions. A first wave of optimizations is now live to improve smoothness and performance. This is just the beginning. 🚀
As always, more balance tweaks based on your feedback, bugs squashed, and more surprises on the way.
Hold the line, never surrender! 🪖

🚨 This is a major update, the first of many to come!
We’re kicking things off with our initial improvements to the Endless Mode, and to the Codex. This is just the beginning, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.
♾️ Endless Mode: Improved!

We’ve reworked Endless Mode to offer larger battlefields and longer sessions, while making the pacing more gradual, less punishing, and ultimately more rewarding. It’s still a challenge, but now it’s a more strategic one.
📖 Codex & Upgrades

We worked on improving the Codex. You can now easily hover over a building to preview its upgrade paths. Finally, the Codex is now also accessible in-game, letting you quickly consult it before placing a tower or choosing a reward. 🧠
Additions / Improvements: ✨
New Endless mode
Codex now available in game
Codex now displays Buildings upgrades on mouse-hover
Clearer tooltip explanation for Unseen codex element vs. Locked element
Add a default Frame limit option if Vsync is Off
Add Visual Feedback on HQ Damage: Balance Changes: ⚖️
Increased Rampart silo missiles travel speed
Electric arc cannon High-grade capacitor now reads “+4 Range per Battlefront”

Fixed an incorrect interaction between Z23 Reinforced Structure and the amount of Battlefronts
Fixed an issue resulting in foes’ spawn being diminished: We’re far from done, there's still plenty more to come, and we're going to continue listening to you and improving the game!

Today’s update focuses on resolving issues with how the game saves and processes unlock conditions for heroes, towers, doctrines, and badges. These changes are aimed at preventing incorrect unlocks, or worse, not receiving them at all. 🔓
You should no longer encounter problems like receiving the wrong badge for the difficulty you completed, or not receiving a badge despite meeting the requirements. 🎖️
We’ve also updated how the game saves your progress to reduce the risk of data loss when quitting the game, including abrupt exits. Your progression should now be reliably preserved. 💾✅

This update lays the groundwork for several big changes coming soon, including a major rework of how difficulty scales in Endless Mode. Our goal is to enable larger-scale battles and offer deeper strategic possibilities. Before building on top of the current systems, we wanted to ensure the game’s foundation is solid and reliable. 🧱🛡️
Thank you for your support and valuable feedback, it helps us focus on what truly matters. We’re excited for what’s ahead and can’t wait to share more with you in the next updates! 🚀
Additions / Improvements: ✨
Tooltips of Neutral buildings now directly display their effects
Advanced Imperial barracks colors now match with their weapons
New bomber sound effect: Bug fixes: 👾
Fixed an issue when quitting the game could result in an unlock never being completed
Fixed an issue where a properly unlocked Foe, Doctrine, or Building was not properly being unlocked.
Cleaned up display of commanders having Frontier 19 badge while having never played any Frontier mode
Fixed an issue resulting in progression being lost (this fix does NOT retroactively restore saved progressions)
Today’s update delivers many improvements, with a primary focus on fixing an issue that affected badge rewards in Frontier mode.

Many of you have reported not receiving the correct badge after completing expeditions in Frontier mode... and thanks to your detailed reports, we tracked down the culprit and fixed this annoying bug. 👾🛠️
While we can't retroactively grant past badges, we deeply appreciate your dedication and hope you enjoy unlocking new achievements from here on out!
On a lighter note, Ctrekoz on Discord pointed out that Warden Gerhard’s ability “Anti-tank warfare” was lacking a bit of flair (and, well… actual tanks), so we knew it was time for a rename!
Without missing a beat, Colonel Astor launched a community vote to choose a new name - and it was Alacarin’s suggestion that came out on top! 🏆
The ability now goes by the name of : “Imperial Supervision” - perfectly grim, just like Gerhard himself. ^^
We sincerely appreciate your continued feedback and engagement - it truly helps guide our work in making the game more balanced, polished, and enjoyable for all players! 🤝

The battlefield never rests - and we're right here listening to your reports and refining the front. This is only the first update in a series of ongoing improvements, made possible by your feedback and continued support! 🛠️
Today’s update brings a focused round of improvements aimed at balance, clarity, and smoother gameplay.
Endless Mode has been re-tuned to scale more gradually beyond standard game length, giving skilled commanders a better shot at reaching higher waves without being overwhelmed too quickly. ⚡
Several HQ bonuses and defenses have been adjusted, key UI elements clarified, and a wide set of bugs are resolved to make everything feel sharper and more consistent.
Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. We’re committed to improving the game together, one update at a time! 🤝🚀
Balance Changes: ⚖️
Decreased Endless mode difficulty by 20%

The dust from the game's launch has barely settled, and already tens of thousands of brave commanders have joined the Battlefield! And many more are coming every day! Big thanks to all of you! 🫶

Today, we’re deploying a first patch 1.07 fixing two specific issues: The VSync option resetting, and the camera sometimes moving by itself. This first patch also addresses a few other minor bugs and tweaks, as you can read below. This is only the beginning, and the very first of many game updates that we will deploy to continuously improve your experience on the battlefields of Tower Dominion. 🪖

In the coming days and weeks, we’ll be rolling out multiple game improvements, fixes, and adjustments, based on your reports from the trenches! We are taking all your valuable feedback to heart and are reviewing all your comments. We are working on a roadmap, and are confident that you won’t be disappointed. Be assured of our commitment to you and to the game. 🤝🎯
(And yes: the Lions of Ravelski are going to get some love ^^)
Fixed an issue with camera movement being stuck
Fixed an issue with Sanction cannon weapon stats disappearing
Fixed Vsync parameter not properly initialized at loading
Fixed GameSoundVolume value not properly assigned in the settings view

Patch 0.83 is here, bringing a fresh round of improvements, balance changes, and key fixes, all shaped by your feedback and our latest testing. From enhanced explosives to smarter unit behavior, this update aims to deliver smoother gameplay, tighter control over each fight, and a cleaner battlefield experience. Let’s get into the details !
Lion of Raveski commanders now go to shortest path with foes
Increased C2-mine explosion size by 20%
Increased C2-min rate of fire by 30%
New option “Forfeit”
New keybinding options
Texts improvement
Fixed Neutral building still being visually activated when cancelling a building
Fixed wrong interaction between music and Continue
Fixed weapons sounds triggering even if the shell’s landing was out of screen
It is no longer possible to validate unlocks conditions by cancelling and placing several times the same building

Fixed issues with the unlock system unlocking items too early: These updates are part of our ongoing mission to refine the battlefield experience and keep the challenge tough but rewarding. Thank you for your support, stay strong, and as always, hold the line !
⚔️ PATCH NOTE 0.81 ⚔️
Greetings, soldiers! The battlefield is shifting once again!

After analyzing combat data and intel from the frontlines, we’re rolling out a fresh wave of balance updates and key improvements. We’ve made some minor tweaks to the gameplay dynamics, like faster commander spawns, improved unit targeting and adjusted costs.
We’ve also added Polish language and are introducing new keybinding mechanics. Let’s break it down!
To clarify which changes affect which version, we will use this emoji (🪖) to indicate updates that apply to the Demo.
🪖Increased Lions of Ravelski commanders spawn speed by 60 %
🪖Decreased Scout hideout - Farsight target system cost to 10 (from 25)
🪖Decreased Retribution position - Forbidden explosives cost to 3250 (from 3500)
🪖Decreased Super heavy pulse defense - Overloading cells cost to 4500 (from 5500)
🪖Medium mortar B3 now targets Farthest from HQ instead of Most HP, optimizing its battlefield role
Decreased Volcanic underground damage to 5 % (from 10 %)
Increased Joint operations center spawn rate by 30 %
🪖Polish language support
🪖Kladen upgrade text now in line with other upgrades
🪖Support for rebinding keyboard keys

These changes will open up new tactical possibilities, refine battlefield balance, and give you greater control over your defenses. Thank you for your support, stay strong, and as always—hold the line !
